Team, the TMS deploy window is Friday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Freeze starts Thursday 18:00. Please hold non-critical changes until the window closes.

The EDI outage is resolved. Failed transmissions retried 5 times with exponential backoff, and the remainder landed in the dead-letter queue for 30 days, per the retry policy. No action needed.
